title: Surreal Cosmic Eye
description: A highly detailed surreal painting of a giant human eye dominating the composition, its iris containing a miniature fantastical landscape with two robed figures, multiple smaller eyes, an orange sun, books, and a snake. The upper eyelid is covered in flowers while the background shows a desert hill with potion bottles, an ornate book with an eye, and a large cracked purple planet floating in a starry sky.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a massive human eye with long black lashes, the iris depicting a miniature fantasy world containing two robed figures, multiple floating eyes, an orange sun, open books, and a large patterned snake emerging from the eye.
